title: Chapter 148
text:
Bun-hit-dog had his eyes set on "Galaxy" as the next video series. As there was very little information on the official website, he was sharp enough to find an opportunity to do a series of commentary and introduction videos. He liked "Galaxy" very much.

A popular game would definitely spawn many video creators. Usually, the first person to release a video would be able to use the game's popularity as long as the quality was good.

However, Pork Bun Beat Dog had not found a good entry point. The first video was very important, and he did not want to be perfunctory. It would be best if he could make some interesting content that normal players would not have access to.

The appearance of Han Xiao made Pork Bun Beat Dog feel that the opportunity had come.

Black Phantom was very popular on the forum. If the first video was about Black Phantom, it would definitely attract the interest of the players. Who would not be curious about this mysterious high-level figure that appeared first? He could use this popularity to make the video popular!

Pork Bun Beat Dog, who was in the crowd, immediately turned on the recording function, aimed at Black Phantom, and started to record the material. The commentary and comments were all added later.

The crowd of players was the influence of the Big Horn Village incident, which saved him a lot of time. He decided not to sell anything (he did not bring anything with him) and just released a list of skills, which required five points of favorability to learn. That meant …

You want to change your class? Just give me money!

"Black Phantom is not selling anything, how do we increase our favorability?"

"This … Do we give him money?"

The players were shocked, whispering, and the crowd was in an uproar.

Han Xiao was calm. He did not need to go through so much trouble in Big Horn Village. Everyone knew that he could change his class here. The price he set seemed to be a scam, but it was actually very straightforward. 2,500 Aquamarine Dollars for a chance to change class to Mechanic. It was up to you whether you want it or not.

Compared to the normal way to get basic knowledge, 2,500 Aquamarine Dollars was a small price to pay.

At this time, Balsas' assistant walked over. He swallowed his saliva nervously and did not dare to get too close to Han Xiao.

"What's the matter?" Han Xiao glanced at him.

"Ahem, what are you doing in Green Valley Town?" the assistant asked.

Han Xiao took a puff of his cigarette. "I'm just passing by. Don't worry, I'm not interested in finding trouble with you."

The assistant heaved a sigh of relief and said, "Then Overmera welcomes your arrival. General Balsas invites you to the town to welcome you."

"No need, I'll just stay here."

Han Xiao shook his head and refused. It was not convenient to communicate with the players in the town. Anyway, the other party would definitely not dare to cause trouble for him. He would leave after collecting the EXP, so he naturally did not care what Balsas thought.

"Yes, yes …" The assistant hurriedly walked away. His heart was beating like a drum, and his back was soaked with cold sweat. The aura of a legendary killer was too scary. Even if Han Xiao didn't move, the assistant was so scared that he almost couldn't stand still.

Especially his eyes, they were as terrifying as the eyes of a wolf in a dark forest. Just being stared at by Han Xiao made the assistant's hair stand on end.

This was one of the uses of Legendary Points. When negotiating with some forces, there would be some additional influence.

When the assistant returned to town, Balsas asked, "What did he say?"

The assistant told him everything in detail.

"Just passing by?" Balsas frowned. The cloud of suspicion did not disperse for a long time. He felt that Black Phantom and the refugees outside had some secrets.

After pondering for a while, he ordered, "Get someone to keep an eye on Black Phantom. Report to me if there are any abnormalities. Also, get some information from those refugees. I have a feeling that Black Phantom is coming for them."

On the other side, the players watched the whole conversation between Han Xiao and Balsas' assistant. Suddenly, they had a question.

They had detection, so of course they knew Black Phantom's name. But how did the assistant know?

Could it be that Black Phantom was very famous on this planet? Was he a big shot that everyone knew?

The players were still at the stage of figuring out the background of Blue Star. The structure of the planet, background, and forces were still like a veiled beauty. They could only understand bits and pieces from the map. It was like scratching an itch through a boot.

Suddenly, the players were very curious about Black Phantom's background.

Figuring out the story of the planet and participating in it was one of the joys of the game.

Bun-hit-dog faithfully recorded the whole process. He was secretly excited. His intuition told him that this was definitely a great hidden element, an explosive point. The identity of Black Phantom could be used as a prelude to unveil the background of the world!

…

While Han Xiao was quietly making a fortune in Green Valley Town, the world situation was surging.

Stardragon, Hesla, Red Maple, Ordina, Theseus, and Raylan — the Six Nations' operation against the Germinal Organization had ended, and the aftermath was gradually showing.

The Six Nations Conference had only been held three times. The first was when the Old Era war ended and the Six Nations' structure was decided.

The second was in the second month after the war. The pollution of the war affected the ecology, and they discussed how to deal with it.

The third was in the fifth year after the war to discuss the placement of the wanderers.

The last six nations of Blue Star were not very close to each other. If it was not a global issue, they would not advance or retreat together.

Today, the fourth Six Nations Conference was held in secret. The topic was the next step of the Germinal Organization's plan. To fight or not to fight?

The conference was held remotely, and the leaders of the Six Nations joined in the communication.

In a sealed meeting room in Stardragon's Dragon Horn Building, the leader of Stardragon sat at one end of the table. On the other end of the table was a big screen showing the images of the leaders of the other five nations.

The corner of the meeting room was full of people. They were all big shots in the military and politics, and Gu Hui was among them. The meeting had been going on for two hours.

"… So, has everyone decided?"

The leader of Ordina said emotionlessly. No one could tell his preference.

The leader of Theseus said in a deep voice, "Raylan, Stardragon, and I agree to send out the troops. Hesla and Red Maple oppose."

The leader of Ordina was silent for three seconds. "I abstain."

Everyone looked like they had guessed it.

Gu Hui did not change his expression. Three votes in favor, two against, and one abstained. He had guessed this result. Theseus and Raylan were the most stubborn. Stardragon had the deepest hatred for the Germinal Organization and would definitely not let go of this opportunity. Hesla and Red Maple were not willing to spend money to start a war. Ordina looked like a bum following the crowd, but in reality, it was always scheming behind the scenes.

The leaders discussed for another hour and decided on the general direction. In the end, they decided that the details of the expedition would be discussed by each country's military.

The big screen went black, and the three-hour-long meeting officially ended.

The leaders in the meeting room looked serious. In the meeting just now, it was decided that the Six Nations would conduct a large-scale military operation on the same scale as the Old Era war, an expedition to Andrea. The Six Nations would advance and retreat together, attacking Andrea from six directions and completely destroying the Germinal Organization.
